title: TotemSkin
description: This mod retextures totems to match the player's skin.
body:
Retextures the Totem of Undying to match the skin of the player holding it.

When a player holds a Totem of Undying, the texture dynamically changes to show a mini version of that player's skin on the totem. Works for both premium and non-premium accounts.

Features:
- Dynamic skin-based totem texture for every player
- Works on multiplayer - each player sees their own skin on the totem
- Config screen via ModMenu + Cloth Config (optional)
- Per-player overrides: set custom or vanilla mode for individual players
- Global and mob totem mode settings
- Smart slot management - up to 8 simultaneous custom totems with distance-based eviction
- Supports both classic and slim (Alex) player models
- Multi-language: EN, RU, PL, DE, FR, ES, PT-BR

Requirements: Fabric API(only for fabric)
Optional: Cloth Config, Mod Menu
